newsitem.title: FRANCE: Production costs slow down in Algerian industry.
newsitem.headline: Production costs slow down in Algerian industry.

text.p: Algeria's state-owned non-oil and gas industry production costs rose 17.3 percent in 1996 compared to 31.5 percent in 1995, the National Office of Satistics (ONS) said on Sunday.

The slowdown was due mainly to more stability in the cost of local materials and to greater stability in the Algerian dinar, said ONS in its press release quoted by the official Algerian news agency APS.

Production costs in privately owned industry, which accounts for one quarter of the country's total non-oil and gas industrial output, increased 12.1 percent in 1996 against 17.4 percent the year before, said the ONS.
